work_tags_evidence_explanation: Each entry keeps its own details and references. Repeated labels stay separate, and redirected Concepts stay separate.
work_tags_more_in_read: This preview shows the first 24 entries. Open Details for the rest of this view, or continue in the relation reader for further pages.
work_tags_page_boundary: This page is not the full tag list. Details keeps the facts and evidence for this view. Further pages are in the relation reader and may be unavailable.
work_tags_preview: Tags in this view. Order comes from the catalogue and does not indicate weight.
work_tags_source_meaning: VNDB rating points greater than 0 and at most 3. This is not a REZICS rating or import confidence.
work_tags_unavailable: Tag evidence is unavailable. Try this work again.
work_tags_weight_explanation: Keep this entry and its evidence. A missing or unsupported weight has no inferred score or scale.
work_tags_weight_unavailable: The provided weight could not be read reliably.
zone_editor_actions_unavailable: Actions could not be loaded. Editing is disabled. Try again.
zone_editor_closed: This action is currently unavailable for your account.
zone_editor_composition_note: Edit blocks and appearance in the page editor. That editor is a local draft; placeholders are not a saved preview.
zone_editor_conflict: The saved version changed. Your edits are still here. Reload to discard them, or reapply them to the latest version before saving again.
zone_editor_copy_failed: Could not copy. Use the reader link above.
zone_editor_denied: Your current access does not allow this action.
zone_editor_dirty: You have unsaved edits. Save before previewing or changing visibility.
zone_editor_leave: Leave this page and discard unsaved edits?
zone_editor_live_note: Saving replaces the current version. Public and unlisted Zones update immediately. Anyone with an unlisted link may open it without signing in.
zone_editor_navigation_note: Up to 16 pages, including Home. Navigation follows the configured page order.
zone_editor_preview_note: Preview shows the saved page with your current access. Unsaved changes are not included. The reader link opens the saved version.
zone_editor_published: Visibility updated for the saved version.
zone_editor_refresh: Reload the latest version and choices
zone_editor_release: Available filters from release {release}. Saving uses the active release.
zone_editor_route_help: Use lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, with / between segments. Do not start or end with /. The first segment cannot be "subjects". Leave the Home path empty.
zone_editor_signed_out: Sign in again to continue. Your edits are still here.
zone_editor_source_note: You can select only released, saved filters and Collections you can read. Visibility does not grant access to their sources. A source may be unavailable.
zone_editor_source_unavailable: This source is not ready. No preview is available.
zone_editor_validation: Review the marked configuration fields before saving.
zone_name_fallback: Readers see a name in their language when available; otherwise they see the primary name.
zone_name_invalid: Enter a name in {language} of 1–80 characters, without markup or control characters.
zone_name_legacy: This older Zone has no primary language. The first available name is used, in this order: English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Spanish. Editing a name or choosing a language sets the primary language.
zone_name_translation_help: Write translations yourself. Add a language only when you have a name for it.
zone_preparing_message: This page is being prepared. Please try again in a moment.
zone_recovery_composition: Review this page's blocks and appearance in the page editor. Check required fields, allowed values, and page limits.
zone_recovery_generic: Review the configuration and the latest version. This does not point to a specific field. See technical details.
zone_recovery_mounts: Choose at most 16 different Collections you can read. Remove or replace any you cannot use.
zone_recovery_names: Choose a supported primary language and enter its name. Review any translations already present.
zone_recovery_pages: Keep the Home path empty. Use at most 16 pages, each with a unique path, in sorted order.
zone_recovery_preview: The saved page could not be previewed. Your unsaved edits were not sent. Preview uses your current access.
zone_recovery_publish_unknown: The visibility update is unconfirmed and may already have taken effect. Check the latest version before applying visibility again.
zone_recovery_read: This information was not included. Try again to see if it is available.
zone_recovery_retained: Your edits are still here. Review the guidance and check your access or the version conflict before submitting again.
zone_recovery_save_unknown: The save is unconfirmed and may already have taken effect. Your edits are still here. Check the latest version before deciding whether to save again.
zone_recovery_scopes: Choose at most 16 distinct saved filters from the available release. Remove or replace an invalid selection.
zone_recovery_source: A required source is not ready. Try again when it is available.
zone_recovery_unavailable: This operation could not be completed or confirmed.
zone_recovery_visibility: Choose Private, Unlisted or Public for the saved version. Save your edits before changing visibility.
zone_recovery_write_unknown: The change is unconfirmed and may already have taken effect. Your edits are still here. Check the latest version before deciding whether to submit again.
zone_unavailable_heading: This Zone page is temporarily unavailable
zone_unavailable_message: We could not load this Zone page. Try again after a moment.
zones_create_intro: Start a private site from an existing starter. Give it a primary name before creating it.
zones_create_names_help: Choose a primary name and its language. One name is enough, up to 80 characters. Changing the interface language keeps your names.
zones_create_reader_help: Open checks access separately. Creating a Zone does not grant access to source data.
zones_create_saved: Your private Zone was created. Continue to its saved configuration.
zones_create_starter_help: The starter is copied only when you create this Zone. Later releases do not update it. Pages that use a source still require access to that source, and the feature must be available.
zones_create_uncertain: The result is uncertain. Your form is locked. Retry repeats the original request.
zones_create_visibility: This Zone will be private. Change its visibility separately in configuration.
zones_owner_actor: This account cannot do this in its current state.
zones_owner_closed: This feature is not available to your account.
zones_owner_confirm_description: Readers will lose access. You can restore this Zone within 30 days; its sources stay unchanged.
zones_owner_conflict: The Zone changed, the restore window ended, or the request was blocked. Refresh before trying again.
zones_owner_denied: Your current permissions do not allow this action. Refresh after access changes.
zones_owner_empty_help: Choose a starter to create your first private site.
zones_owner_expired: The restore deadline has passed. Refresh to see what is available.
zones_owner_intro: Manage your sites and open their reader.
zones_owner_invalid: Some values were not accepted. Review your inputs or refresh this list.
zones_owner_missing: This Zone is no longer available. Refresh the list.
zones_owner_signed_out: Sign in to manage your Zones.
zones_owner_stale: This page link is no longer current. Start from the first page.
zones_owner_trash_help: You can restore a deleted Zone until its 30-day deadline.
zones_owner_unavailable: The request could not be confirmed. Check the same request again.
